name: Creem
summary: A newer Merchant of Record built for indie SaaS, AI tools, and digital products, combining global tax handling with product and growth tooling.

pricing.headline: 3.9% + $0.40 per transaction on tax-inclusive order value; chargebacks are $25 and payout fees can apply.
pricing.assumptions: Public standard platform fee. The percentage applies to tax-inclusive order value. Chargebacks cost $25; bank and USDC payout fees vary by payout route.

sellerCoverage: Digital businesses can apply subject to supported-country, product, identity, and risk checks.
buyerCoverage: Creem markets global payment and tax coverage, with methods and availability dependent on buyer and seller location.
products: SaaS, AI tools, software, licenses, digital downloads, memberships, and other approved digital products.

features.checkout: Hosted checkout and developer integrations designed for fast self-serve launches.
features.subscriptions: Recurring plans, trials, upgrades, cancellations, customer portal, and webhooks.
features.invoicing: Tax-compliant transaction documents are provided; confirm complex B2B invoicing requirements.
features.paymentMethods: Cards and supported wallets or local methods through Creem's payment infrastructure.
features.payouts: Net proceeds are paid after a documented risk-hold period and any applicable limits.

responsibilities.note: Creem acts as Merchant of Record and handles supported transaction taxes.
Creem runs the transaction layer while sellers remain bound by policies and evidence requests.
The seller must deliver the digital product and handle product-specific support.
Creem payouts still need to be reconciled in the seller's books.

strengths: Low public base rate for an MoR
Built for indie SaaS and AI products
License keys, affiliates, and revenue splits in one product
limitations: Payout holds and payout fees affect cash timing
The fee base includes tax and complex enterprise billing may need confirmation
avoidIf: You require a mature enterprise service organization
You cannot tolerate platform payout holds
